title: Variational Inference Aided Variable Selection For Spatially Structured High Dimensional Covariates
details: S Nandy, M Kim, S Bhattacharya, T Maiti - Journal of Computational and Graphical …, 2025
abstract: We consider the problem of Bayesian high dimensional variable selection in linear regression when a spatial structure exists among the covariates. We use an Ising prior to model the structural connectivity of the covariates with an undirected graph …
